# [PR #431] docs: fix broken links

source: https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-bench/pull/431
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-25T20:05:00Z
labels: 

## 正文

Fixes broken links in the docs:

- Internal links written as `/docs/...` render as `/docs/docs/...` and return 404, for example the "Formal Specification" links on the FlashInfer Trace page.
- The tracing config link in the "Bring Your Own Kernel" tutorial points to `tracing/builtin/configs.py`, which was removed in #133.
